subject: per-phy-u-find
title: PER.PHY.U.FUND.------TRS.
description: Chart on book p. 99 ((AF)D-27). PER-PHY-U-FIND is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; TRS (transition) is the partner. The title names PER-PHY-U-FUND (perceived physical universe fundamental); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: LANG-DY (language dynamics) and INFO-CO. From INFO-CO: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and IF-SPT (infra-spirituality). From T-C-IMP: GRAD (gradualism). From IF-SPT: WO-MTH (world methodology) and A-PR (all-purpose). From GRAD: IST-F-ACT.
